issues: Eyes are black round bricks sticking straight out of the face like cylinders. The concept has large, flat, glossy 2x2 dome eyes with a white highlight.
Ears are short 2x2 stubs. The concept ears are tall, pointed and angled out, with tan inner faces.
The pink nose is small and sits too low under the eyes. It should sit on the tan muzzle, right between and just below the eyes.
The head reads as a flat box. It needs more height at the crown so it looks rounder and bigger than the body.
The tail is fine, but the stripes on the body and head are sparse compared with the concept's bold tabby bands.
distilled: A chunky, symmetrical orange tabby cat sitting upright, facing the viewer, with a round head, two pointed slope-brick ears, a cream muzzle and chest, and a short stubby tail built from two or three bricks curling up behind.
label: r2
